name: Admin Toolbar Mediteran
description: Replicates the UI improvements of Admin Toolbar module as Mediteran Drupal 8 UI
project_description:
This module improves the UI of Admin Toolbar module to work along with Mediteran Drupal 8 administration theme , it's useful for having the same look and feel of admin toolbar when using Mediteran as your admin theme.

 This module is only suitable to be used along with Mediteran admin theme, but can also be used with any other admin theme

 Requirements: 

 
 Admin Toolbar 
 
  

 Plays Nice With: 

 
 Mediteran Admin Theme 
 Coffee Mediteran [Functionality merged into this module, not needed anymore] 
 
  

 Special thanks to bataboza for his initial code on Mediteran theme
